items.information: **The Bolivia Cubing Tour Santa Cruz 2025** will be the first competition of an exciting tour that will take place **in four different cities across Bolivia, between January 19 and 26**. This will be the perfect opportunity for competitors from all over the country to join a unique speedcubing experience, enjoying thrilling tournaments in various locations. This competition is open to all public. To see all the information about register payment go to the next [link](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BoliviaCubingTourSCZ2025#52958-informacion-de-pago-payment-information) **More information about the competitions enter to: [Frequently Asked Questions / FAQ] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BoliviaCubingTourSCZ2025#52960-faq-pmf)** **El Bolivia Cubing Tour Santa Cruz 2025** será la primera competencia de un emocionante tour que se llevará a cabo en **cuatro ciudades diferentes de Bolivia, entre el 19 y el 26 de enero**. Esta será la oportunidad perfecta para los competidores de todo el país de unirse a una experiencia única de speedcubing, disfrutando de emocionantes torneos en distintas localidades. Esta competencia esta abierta a todo publico. items.information: This competition only has the blindfolded events and Fewest Moves. If you're looking for a more conventional cubing competition, you might be interested in [this one](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PBsinPalisadesOpen2025). Due to the limited space, each competitor can bring at most 1 guest during the competition. The Harry & Thelma Adler community room is located on the 4th floor in front of the Ice Skating Rink on your right hand side. items.information: ![Image description](https://b2b989d215c701ad63d7-288404e13f895703cf2798bf6ae95228.ssl.cf1.rackcdn.com/734655566969-350.png) ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ0dKIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--60fae70c3e469b91d58257f4370c58af47b487da/scswcc5.png) #### SacCubing returns with our 19th iteration! Make sure to sign up early to reserve your spot! * *If we run ahead of schedule, we will start first round events no earlier than 20 minutes, so please show up at least 20 minutes before your first event.* * We will be assigning judging assignments to competitors for the group before or after their own competing groups. Please check your personal competitor cards when we assign them a week before the competition date for relevant info. * All donations are appreciated and will go towards things such as venue fees, supplies and other competition expenses.

items.name: UCSD Big and Blind 2025

venue.name: UC San Diego
venue.address: Price Center, UCSD, 9500 Gilman Dr, La Jolla, CA 92093

items.information: This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UCSDBigandBlind2025#43214-competitor-responsibilities) tab. Spectators can attend for free and can come and go as they please! No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating. This competition is organized in partnership with [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/) and [SpeedCubeShop](https://speedcubeshop.com/). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ0dKIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--60fae70c3e469b91d58257f4370c58af47b487da/scswcc5.png)
